task_description: Fix all broken interactive actions (edit, sync, connect buttons), add PnL Calendar heatmap to metrics views, add Finances page for expenses/payouts tracking, and enhance Groups with daily PnL and more stats.

All features verified: broken actions fixed, PnL Calendar added to metrics and account detail, Finances page created with CRUD, Groups enhanced with daily PnL and stats. Review issues fixed: (1) Reconnect no longer disconnects, (2) useParams.id used in Account Detail, (3) Group stats derived from data, (4) Finances persists to localStorage, (5) Win Rate card merged into stats grid.
